mapper.select: SELECT B.CAL_NM, B.CAL_TITLE, B.CAL_CONTENT, B.CAL_START, B.CAL_END, B.TEXT_COLOR, B.BG_COLOR, B.USER_NO, B.CALENDAR_TY, B.FILE_GROUP_NO, B.CAL_STATUS, B.CAL_REG_DATE, B.READER_NO, B.CAL_CNT, (SELECT U.USER_NM FROM TB_USER U WHERE B.USER_NO = U.USER_NO) AS USER_NM FROM CALENDAR B JOIN TB_USER U ON B.USER_NO = U.USER_NO WHERE B.CALENDAR_TY = 2 AND B.CAL_STATUS = 1 ORDER BY B.CAL_NM DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO calendar ( cal_nm, cal_title, cal_content, cal_start, cal_end, text_color, bg_color, user_no, calendar_ty ,file_group_no ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(cal_nm), 0) + 1 FROM calendar), #{calTitle}, #{calContent}, #{calStart}, #{calEnd}, #{textColor}, #{bgColor}, #{userNo}, 2 ,20250203016 )

insert into calendar (CAL_NM, CAL_TITLE, CAL_CONTENT,CAL_START, CAL_END,USER_NO, CALENDAR_TY, CAL_REG_DATE) values((select nvl(max(cal_nm),0)+1 from calendar), #{calTitle},#{calContent},#{calStart},#{calEnd},#{userNo},2,SYSDATE)
